cli_err_unknown_account: Unknown account: {ref}. Run `metadash accounts` to see the keys and usernames.
cli_err_ambiguous_account: {ref} matches more than one account. Use platform:@username or the account key:
cli_err_unknown_client: No accounts with client name {value}. Clients:
cli_err_period_required: This template needs a period: --period or --from/--to.
cli_err_single_account: The {template} template covers one account, but {n} were selected. Put {account} in --out to write one file per account.
cli_err_no_account_for_template: The {template} template covers all accounts; filter with --tag or --platform instead of --account/--client.
cli_err_account_token: {account} in --out needs an account template; {template} writes a single file.
cli_err_out_collision: Several reports would be written to the same file. Add {account} or {platform} to --out.
cli_err_query_required: --query <name> or --sql "SELECT …" is required. See `metadash export list`.
cli_err_csv_one_query: CSV holds one query; use xlsx for several.
cli_err_passphrase_env: Environment variable {name} is empty or not set.
cli_read_only: This is a shared (read-only) team workspace; the command changes data and is disabled here.
cli_platform_not_enabled: {platform} is not enabled in this version; it is skipped.
cli_sync_locked_app: A sync is already running in the MetaDash app (since {since}). Try again when it finishes.
cli_sync_locked_other: Another sync is already running (command line or another process, since {since}). Try again when it finishes.
cli_sync_no_profile: No platform is connected. Connect an account in the app first (Setup).
cli_sync_token_invalid: The {auth} connection's token is missing or unreadable. Reconnect it in the app.
cli_sync_summary: Sync {status}: {done}/{total} jobs, {calls} API calls, {errors} errors, {seconds} s.
cli_sync_demo: Demo data: no API calls were made; the demo dataset moved forward.
cli_sync_auth_failed: Connections that need to be reconnected in the app: {list}.
cli_report_ai_failed: AI commentary failed ({error}); the report is written without it.
cli_export_truncated: {name}: only the first {n} rows were exported.
cli_backup_no_secrets: No --passphrase-env: tokens and app secrets are left out of the backup.
cli_shim_bad_dir: {dir} is not an existing folder (use an absolute path).
cli_shim_exists: {file} already exists and is not a MetaDash shim; it was left untouched.
